reviews.text: So I came in one Sunday with my cat, who had a nosebleed and blood in his urine. I was pleasantly surprised to have to pay an emergency fee of €77 plus a consultation fee of €55. €133 for a consultation seems a bit steep. There are no prices displayed to inform the customer. I'm therefore reposting my previous review, which was magically deleted. They push unnecessary tests to inflate the bill. Avoid at all costs...

Thank you for your positive feedback. We strive to improve our services every day, both for you, the owners, and for our valued patients.
Sincerely
I'm very happy with this veterinary center. I recommend it 🙏

Very disappointed with this consultation.

I took my 10-year-old cat in for a general check-up and to make sure everything was alright. The consultation was rushed. The vet quickly looked at his front teeth and told me "they're fine," even though the most tartar-covered teeth were precisely the back ones.

I then asked her if he wasn't overweight. Her response: "Well, it shows, doesn't it?" Thanks for the expertise and explanation.

On the other hand, she had more time to talk about her "revolutionary brush" and her dewormer, which was apparently effective, unlike others that "haven't worked for years."

I won't even mention the condescending tone used during the exchange.

The result: a €95 bill, including €50 for a flea treatment pipette whose price, of course, wasn't mentioned to me before it was applied.

I came looking for a proper examination, answers, and advice for my cat's health. I left with a botched consultation and a €50 pipette.

A pipette and a lot of nonsense.
I made a phone call today and spoke to Laetitia; she was wonderful and very patient. Thank you so much!

Excellent vets, welcoming, and very attentive. No complaints.

One star because there's no less.
This is the sixth time I've called. Each time, I wait about ten minutes before the call is disconnected, without being able to speak to anyone.
This situation is truly unacceptable. Either you're able to take calls, or you're not, but it's not normal to make people wait so long only to hang up on them.
And yet, it's a time when there's no call volume. Let's just say the first contact was very poor. Systematic hanging up.

I came in without an appointment for a complicated nail trim on my dog.
I received a very warm welcome and excellent service from Corinne and Nicolas.

I thank them for their kindness and patience.

Thank you to Dr. Coulon for his kindness, attentiveness, and professionalism. He took the time to examine my cat very gently and answered all my questions. You can feel his experience and love for animals. It's very reassuring to be able to rely on such a competent and caring veterinarian. Meryl
Excellent young vets who love animals. Vet network.

I made an appointment to have my 7-month-old cat spayed. From the start, I was very disappointed by the lack of information regarding the procedure and post-operative care. Despite this, I decided to trust them.

The day they called me to pick up my cat, I wasn't even seen by the veterinarian who performed the surgery. Only the veterinary assistant briefly explained that there was a bandage on her belly, that I should prevent her from licking it, possibly bandage it, remove the bandage after 4 days, and come back to have the stitches removed if they didn't dissolve on their own after 12 days.

Once home, she obviously tried to remove the bandage. I tried following their advice with a simple bandage, but it doesn't stay on a cat at all. So I called the clinic again to ask if I could use an Elizabethan collar, which they advised against in order to “avoid frustrating the cat.” The result: sleepless nights watching her and a makeshift solution with bandages that wouldn't stay on. I finally had to buy an Elizabethan collar myself.

Four days later, it was impossible to remove the bandage: it was extremely stuck to her skin. Since it was Sunday, I had to contact an emergency vet who advised me to wait until Monday. Fortunately, Dr. Mathieu was absolutely wonderful: gentle, professional, reassuring, and very competent. She managed to remove the bandage correctly and took the time to check the condition of the incision. It was also at that point that I learned the stitches weren't dissolvable, contrary to what the veterinary assistant had told me. I find it unacceptable that a veterinary assistant would give incorrect information regarding post-operative care.

A few days later, I went back to the clinic to have the stitches removed. Once again, no vet took the time to examine my pet or properly check the incision. Everything was handled solely by the veterinary nurses. When I got home, I was assured I could remove the cone immediately. As soon as I took it off, she started licking the incision excessively again. So I had to put it back on for several more days.

As if that weren't enough, she caught fleas while at the clinic on the day of the surgery. We ended up with an infestation throughout the entire apartment, which was a nightmare for over a month. When I called the clinic for advice, I received no real help or support. I had to manage on my own through the internet and contact another veterinary clinic to get reliable advice.

During our visit to have the stitches removed, we were deeply shocked and disturbed by a very distressing scene: in the waiting room, the veterinary assistants carried a deceased animal in their arms in front of all the clients, without any blanket or discretion. Out of respect for the owners present and for the animal itself, this seemed extremely inappropriate and very shocking.

Today, more than a month after the surgery, my cat is vomiting and fatigued, and I just noticed that a stitch wasn't even removed properly.

This experience has been catastrophic from beginning to end. I will now consult another veterinary practice for a complete check-up of my cat's health.

We entrust our animals to professionals so they receive the best possible care. Here, I found neither support, nor serious follow-up, nor genuine veterinary care. The veterinary assistants constantly overstep the bounds of the veterinarians, prevent any direct communication with them, and sometimes give inappropriate advice.

I absolutely do not recommend this veterinary practice.

A truly exceptional clinic, one of the few that still exist today, with a genuine commitment to animal welfare.
The staff is very attentive, caring, and always offers excellent advice.
I am incredibly grateful to Dr. Coulomb, whom I consulted today after a very bad experience at another clinic. Thank you for your kindness, gentleness, and kindness with my little cat, and for your professionalism, which deeply touched me. I was apprehensive about this appointment, but you were able to put my daughter at ease and provide her with top-quality care.

Thank you again.
We are so lucky to have you.
Wishing you all the best! ❤️🐾🐾

A huge thank you to Manon Maurel for the exceptional care she provided to my cat Dina, from the diagnosis of her illness until her final moments.

She is a remarkable professional: gentle, caring, and attentive, she knows how to find the right words in difficult situations. Her explanations are always clear and easy to understand, and she makes herself available whenever needed, always finding a time that works for her.

It's rare to encounter caregivers who are so compassionate and dedicated.
Thank you so much for everything. 🙏

If we could write hundreds of lines to express our gratitude and esteem for Dr. Manon Maurel, we would. She has been caring for our animals for years and has supported us through incredibly difficult times with extraordinary gentleness and kindness (after the loss of our first dog, she took the time to speak to each member of my family on the phone).

When we adopt a pet, we do so with complete peace of mind because we know it will be in the best possible hands. Knowing that they are cared for by Dr. Maurel gives us immense confidence.

She gives genuine attention to each animal and to the owners; she listens to us, explains things to us, and reassures us.

You are invaluable to us!

A huge thank you for absolutely everything and for everyone, Dr. Maurel!

With all our love,
Simone, Bruce, the birds, the turtles, Tayzon, Flocon, Carmeline, Angelo, Romain, Marina, and Kevin. ❤️

Dr. Maurel is a great listener and explains things very clearly. She inspires great confidence in both the animal and the owner. Her professionalism and kindness are simply extraordinary. A big thank you for Ilie.

A clinic where you're always greeted with a smile and genuine care. Sound advice is always readily available.

The key to this place is undoubtedly the professionalism, empathy, and deep, sincere love for animals demonstrated by Dr. Manon Maurel, a veterinarian, along with her unwavering commitment to the care she provides. We adore her!

A huge thank you to Dr. Maurel for her exceptional follow-up and outstanding quality of care. Appointments are quick and very efficient. Dr. Maurel listens attentively and explains things very clearly. She is truly reassuring. I highly recommend her.

A big thank you for Ilie.
We received excellent service. Both the reception staff and the vet answered all our questions. Truly professional and inexpensive...
Super
Thank you for the warm welcome on the phone. Happy New Year!

Our two cats, Mistral and Hermes, are seen at the clinic by Dr. Maurel. All the staff are friendly and responsive, and we can always get advice over the phone. Dr. Maurel is a gentle veterinarian who truly cares about the animals' well-being—they are pampered at every appointment. She takes the time to explain everything to us and reassure us!
Thank you for taking such good care of our cats.
We highly recommend this clinic.
Everything is explained from A to Z so that there's no need to worry.
It looks good on the website to mention that the clinic is open on Sundays, but you also need to answer the phone when we call you!!! Zero stars 👌🏼 …

I can always bring my cat in for an emergency between appointments, the staff are attentive, and the diagnosis is good. It's a shame the medications are quite expensive, like elsewhere. I recommend them.
We received a very warm welcome and were very professional! Excellent clinic. Thank you all.
They refused to give me an emergency appointment even though the treatment prescribed by this vet wasn't correct. They're not taking responsibility. Avoid this clinic!

I have just been to the clinic as I needed to start the procedure of returning to the UK with my dog. I cannot express how helpful the clinic was in this regard. They knew exactly what was needed and the process was performed quickly and inexpensively. The vet spoke perfect English and was extremely helpful. If you are in the St. B area and need help, go straight here.

I took my dog ​​to have a blood glucose sensor fitted. It only lasted a week, not even that long, before it came off. I repeat, it was because it was improperly fitted. What they offered me was to buy another sensor and come back to have it fitted again! Of course, at my expense!!! And if the sensor doesn't stay in place because they fitted it incorrectly again, I have to buy another one, and so on... They are truly dishonest. I will never set foot in their shop again. That's it.

I took my beloved dog to the vet in the middle of the night from Saturday to Sunday in critical condition. The indifferent vet, who took things very lightly, effectively prevented us from being with our dog in his final hours, but on the other hand, didn't hesitate to charge us over 600 euros.
We had to fight to get the dog back early the next morning so he could be with us and we could try to get to another vet at 8 a.m. on Monday.
The dog died in our arms that morning.
We're supposed to be in a civilized country, but my deep resentment towards this vet is beyond words… This clinic is nothing more than a money-making machine.
It's possible my dog ​​would have survived somewhere else…

Helpful staff, and emergency service available.
Very professional.
Excellent service and the care my cats received was very pleasant, but the prices are exorbitant and downright dishonest… €105 for a cortisone injection and an antibiotic injection…

Thank you to Dr. Coulon and the clinic staff for their warm welcome, kindness, and professionalism.
They love animals, and it shows!
Top-notch vet!
Dr. Coulon is truly an excellent veterinarian; he's good in all areas. A big thank you!
